blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY—The Baguio Water District (BWD) on Monday urged residents to avoid panic buying and hoarding water amid concerns over the possible effects of Super El Niño, warning that unnecessary stockpiling could put additional pressure on available water resources. According to BWD General Manager Engr. Salvador Royeca, a sudden increase in water consumption could make it more difficult to distribute available supply equitably, particularly during the dry months. Royeca acknowledged public concerns over a possible water shortage but urged households and business establishments to conserve water instead of stockpiling it out of fear.
